senses.en: the quality of having strong moral principles; honesty

ex.en: The judge was respected for her probity and fairness.
ex.zh: 那位法官因正直與公正而受到尊敬。

parts.m: good, honest 好的、正直的（拉丁文 probus）

root.note: 正直的性質

senses.en: an established or official way of doing something
a medical operation

ex.en: Follow the safety procedure carefully when using the machine.
ex.zh: 使用這台機器時，請仔細遵守安全程序。

root.note: 一步步往前走的方式 → 程序

senses.en: to continue or begin a course of action
to move forward to a place

ex.en: Passengers should proceed to gate 12 for boarding.
ex.zh: 旅客請前往 12 號登機門登機。

root.note: 向前走 → 繼續進行

senses.en: a public or official announcement

ex.en: The king issued a proclamation declaring a national holiday.
ex.zh: 國王發布公告，宣布一個國定假日。

root.note: 向前大聲喊出 → 宣言

senses.en: to delay or postpone doing something

ex.en: If you procrastinate, you will have to cram the night before the test.
ex.zh: 如果你拖延，就得在考試前一晚臨時抱佛腳。

parts.m: of tomorrow 明天的（拉丁文 cras）

root.note: 推到明天 → 拖延

senses.en: the habit of delaying or postponing things

ex.en: Procrastination caused him to miss the application deadline.
ex.zh: 拖延讓他錯過了申請截止日期。

root.note: 推到明天的習慣 → 拖延

senses.en: a person who supervises students during an exam
to supervise an exam

ex.en: The proctor collected our phones before the exam began.
ex.zh: 考試開始前，監考人員收走了我們的手機。

parts.m: procurator 代理人、管理者（縮寫）

root.note: 管理者 → 監考人員

senses.en: spending money or resources wastefully
a person who spends money wastefully

ex.en: The prodigal heir spent his fortune in just a few years.
ex.zh: 那個揮霍無度的繼承人短短幾年就把財產花光了。

root.note: 把錢往外趕 → 揮霍的

mn: 聖經中「浪子回頭」就是 the prodigal son。

senses.en: remarkably or impressively great in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: She has a prodigious memory for names and faces.
ex.zh: 她對名字和長相有驚人的記憶力。

parts.m: omen, wonder 奇蹟（拉丁文 prodigium）

root.note: 像奇蹟一樣的 → 驚人的

senses.en: a young person with exceptional talent
an amazing or unusual thing

ex.en: The chess prodigy beat a grandmaster at the age of ten.
ex.zh: 那位西洋棋神童十歲時就打敗了一位特級大師。

root.note: 奇蹟般的人 → 神童

senses.en: producing a lot; achieving useful results

ex.en: I feel most productive in the early morning.
ex.zh: 我在清晨時覺得最有效率。

root.note: 把東西引導出來 → 有生產力的

senses.en: a paid job that requires special training, such as law or medicine
an open declaration of belief or feeling

ex.en: Teaching is a demanding but rewarding profession.
ex.zh: 教書是一份辛苦但很有意義的職業。

root.note: 公開宣誓從事的工作 → 專業

senses.en: a university teacher of the highest rank

ex.en: Our history professor tells great stories in every lecture.
ex.zh: 我們的歷史教授每堂課都會講很精彩的故事。

root.note: 公開講授學問的人 → 教授

senses.en: to offer or hold out something for someone to accept

ex.en: She stepped forward to proffer her hand in greeting.
ex.zh: 她走上前伸出手打招呼。

root.note: 向前遞出 → 提供

senses.en: a high degree of skill; expertise

ex.en: The job requires proficiency in at least two languages.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要精通至少兩種語言。

root.note: 做得很有進展 → 熟練

senses.en: skilled and competent at something

ex.en: You must be proficient in English to study at this university.
ex.zh: 你必須精通英文才能在這所大學就讀。

root.note: 做得很有進展的 → 熟練的

senses.en: a side view of a face or object
a short description of a person or organization
the extent to which someone attracts public attention

ex.en: She updated her online profile with a new photo.
ex.zh: 她用一張新照片更新了自己的網路個人檔案。

root.note: 畫出外形線條 → 側面輪廓

mn: keep a low profile：保持低調。

senses.en: a person who makes unfair profits, especially by selling scarce goods at high prices
to make unfair profits

ex.en: During the storm, a profiteer sold bottled water at ten times the normal price.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，有個奸商用十倍的價格賣瓶裝水。

root.note: 只求利潤的人 → 奸商

senses.en: reckless wastefulness
immoral, shamelessly indulgent behavior

ex.en: The government's profligacy left the country deep in debt.
ex.zh: 政府的揮霍無度讓國家債台高築。

root.note: 被打倒、毀壞 → 揮霍墮落

senses.en: recklessly wasteful of money or resources
shamelessly immoral

ex.en: Critics attacked the city's profligate spending on luxury offices.
ex.zh: 批評者抨擊市政府揮霍公帑打造豪華辦公室。

root.note: 被打垮、毀掉的 → 揮霍、放蕩的

senses.en: produced or given in large amounts
senses.zh: 大量的；豐富的；毫不吝惜的

ex.en: He offered profuse apologies for being late.
ex.zh: 他為遲到連連道歉。

root.note: 往外大量傾倒 → 大量的

senses.en: the descendants or offspring of a person, animal, or plant

ex.en: The farmer hoped the prize bull's progeny would be just as strong.
ex.zh: 農夫希望那頭得獎公牛的後代也同樣強壯。

root.note: 往後生出來的 → 後代

senses.en: the process of developing or moving gradually toward a more advanced state
a sequence of numbers or events

ex.en: The doctor monitored the progression of the disease.
ex.zh: 醫生監測病情的發展。

root.note: 一步步向前 → 進展

senses.en: the action of forbidding something, especially by law
(Prohibition) the period from 1920 to 1933 when alcohol was banned in the U.S.

ex.en: The prohibition on smoking in restaurants began last year.
ex.zh: 餐廳禁菸的禁令從去年開始實施。

root.note: 擋在前面不讓過 → 禁止

senses.en: a person who supports banning the sale of alcohol

ex.en: The prohibitionist gave speeches about the dangers of drinking.
ex.zh: 那位禁酒主義者到處演講飲酒的危害。

root.note: 主張禁（酒）的人

senses.en: serving to forbid or restrict

ex.en: The city posted prohibitory signs along the dangerous cliff.
ex.zh: 市政府在危險的懸崖沿線立了禁止標誌。

root.note: 禁止的

senses.en: an estimate of future amounts based on present trends
the showing of an image on a screen
something that sticks out

ex.en: The sales projection for next year looks very positive.
ex.zh: 明年的銷售預測看起來非常樂觀。

root.note: 往前丟 → 投射、預測

senses.en: relating to the working class
senses.zh: 無產階級的；勞工階級的

senses.en: a member of the working class

ex.en: The novel describes proletarian life in an industrial city.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫工業城市裡勞工階級的生活。

parts.m: citizen of the lowest class 最低階層公民（拉丁文 proles 子孫）

root.note: 古羅馬只有子女沒有財產的階層 → 無產階級

senses.en: producing many works, results, or offspring

ex.en: The prolific author has published more than fifty novels.
ex.zh: 這位多產的作家已經出版了五十多本小說。

root.note: 生出很多後代 → 多產的

senses.en: using too many words; tediously long

ex.en: The report was so prolix that nobody finished reading it.
ex.zh: 這份報告冗長到沒有人讀完。

root.note: 一直往前流個不停 → 冗長的

senses.en: an introductory section of a play, book, or piece of music
an event that leads to another

ex.en: The novel's prologue is set one hundred years before the main story.
ex.zh: 這部小說的序幕發生在主要故事的一百年前。

root.note: 在前面說的話 → 序言

senses.en: to make something last longer

ex.en: Regular exercise can prolong your life.
ex.zh: 規律運動可以延長壽命。

root.note: 往前拉長 → 延長

senses.en: a paved public walk, especially along the sea
a leisurely walk taken for pleasure
to take a leisurely public walk

ex.en: Families strolled along the promenade at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時，一家家人沿著海濱步道散步。

root.note: 往前走 → 散步、散步道

mn: 美國高中舞會 prom 就是 promenade 的縮寫。

senses.en: the state of being important or famous
something that sticks out, such as a hill

ex.en: The young scientist rose to prominence after her discovery.
ex.zh: 這位年輕科學家在有所發現後聲名鵲起。

root.note: 向前突出 → 顯著、知名

senses.en: important or famous
sticking out; easily noticed

ex.en: A prominent scientist will speak at the graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 一位著名的科學家將在畢業典禮上致詞。

root.note: 向前突出的 → 顯眼、著名的

senses.en: having many casual sexual partners
indiscriminate; mixing different things without care

ex.en: The critic complained about the promiscuous use of special effects in the film.
ex.zh: 評論家抱怨這部電影濫用特效。

root.note: 全部混在一起、不挑選 → 雜亂的

senses.en: containing or expressing a promise, especially to pay

ex.en: He signed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan within a year.
ex.zh: 他簽了一張本票，同意一年內還清借款。

root.note: 事先送出承諾的 → 約定的

senses.en: a high point of land that sticks out into the sea

ex.en: A lighthouse stands at the tip of the rocky promontory.
ex.zh: 一座燈塔矗立在岩石海岬的尖端。

root.note: 向前伸出的山 → 海角

senses.en: a person who organizes or finances events such as concerts or sports matches
a supporter of a cause or idea

ex.en: The concert promoter sold all the tickets in one hour.
ex.zh: 演唱會主辦人在一小時內賣光了所有門票。

root.note: 把事情往前推動的人 → 推廣者

senses.en: to make an idea or belief widely known
to officially announce a new law

ex.en: The group used social media to promulgate its ideas.
ex.zh: 這個團體利用社群媒體宣揚他們的理念。

parts.m: milk out, make known 擠出、公開（拉丁文 promulgare）

root.note: 向前公開 → 頒布、宣揚

senses.en: biased or misleading information used to promote a political cause

ex.en: The posters were wartime propaganda designed to stir up hatred.
ex.zh: 這些海報是戰時用來煽動仇恨的宣傳品。

root.note: 應被傳播的東西 → 宣傳

senses.en: to spread an idea or belief widely
to grow new plants from a parent plant

ex.en: Gardeners can propagate roses from small cuttings.
ex.zh: 園丁可以用小段插枝繁殖玫瑰。

parts.m: set, fasten 插枝（拉丁文 propago）

root.note: 用插枝繁殖 → 繁殖、傳播

senses.en: to drive or push something forward
to cause someone to move into a situation

ex.en: A strong wind helped propel the sailboat across the lake.
ex.zh: 強風推動帆船駛過湖面。

root.note: 向前推 → 推進

senses.en: a fuel or gas used to push a rocket or spray from a can

ex.en: The rocket carries liquid oxygen as part of its propellant.
ex.zh: 這枚火箭攜帶液態氧作為推進劑的一部分。

root.note: 向前推的東西 → 推進劑

senses.en: a device with spinning blades that moves a ship or aircraft

ex.en: The small plane's propeller began to spin before takeoff.
ex.zh: 小飛機的螺旋槳在起飛前開始轉動。

root.note: 向前推的裝置 → 螺旋槳

senses.en: a prediction of what will happen in the future

ex.en: The old woman's prophecy about the flood came true.
ex.zh: 那位老婦人對洪水的預言成真了。

root.note: 事先說出 → 預言

senses.en: to say that something will happen in the future

ex.en: No one can prophesy exactly how technology will change our lives.
ex.zh: 沒有人能準確預言科技將如何改變我們的生活。

root.note: 事先說出 → 預言

senses.en: giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable

ex.en: The calm weather made it a propitious time to set sail.
ex.zh: 平靜的天氣正是啟航的好時機。

parts.m: seek, go toward 趨向（拉丁文 petere）

root.note: 往好的方向前進 → 有利的

senses.en: corresponding in size or amount to something else

ex.en: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
ex.zh: 懲罰應該與罪行相稱。

root.note: 依份量分配的 → 成比例的

senses.en: correct social or moral behavior

ex.en: She always behaved with perfect propriety at formal dinners.
ex.zh: 她在正式晚宴上總是舉止得體。

root.note: 合乎本分 → 得體

senses.en: the action of driving or pushing forward

ex.en: Jet propulsion allows planes to fly much faster.
ex.zh: 噴射推進讓飛機飛得更快。

root.note: 向前推 → 推進

senses.en: lacking imagination or excitement; dull and ordinary

ex.en: The truth turned out to be far more prosaic than the rumors.
ex.zh: 事實原來比謠言平淡得多。

root.note: 像散文般平鋪直敘、沒有詩意 → 平淡的

senses.en: the part of a stage in front of the curtain, or the arch framing it

ex.en: The actors bowed beneath the gilded proscenium arch.
ex.zh: 演員們在鍍金的舞台拱門下鞠躬。

root.note: 舞台前面的部分

senses.en: to forbid, especially by law
to denounce or condemn

ex.en: The new rules proscribe the use of phones during class.
ex.zh: 新規定禁止上課時使用手機。

ex.en: The government decided to proscribe the extremist group.
ex.zh: 政府決定取締那個極端團體。

root.note: 古羅馬把罪犯名字公開寫出 → 禁止、放逐

mn: proscribe 是禁止；prescribe 是開處方、規定，只差一個字母意思相反。

senses.en: the act of forbidding something; a ban
the act of outlawing or exiling someone

ex.en: The proscription of certain books only made them more popular.
ex.zh: 禁止某些書反而讓它們更受歡迎。

root.note: 公開寫出名單 → 放逐、禁止

senses.en: a person who has converted from one religion, opinion, or party to another

ex.en: The new proselyte was eager to share his faith with everyone.
ex.zh: 那位新皈依的信徒急著把他的信仰分享給每個人。

root.note: 過來加入的人 → 皈依者

senses.en: the study of the rhythm and sound patterns of poetry
the patterns of stress and intonation in speech

ex.en: Our poetry class spent a week studying prosody and meter.
ex.zh: 我們的詩歌課花了一週研究韻律和格律。

root.note: 配合歌唱的音調 → 韻律

senses.en: a person who searches an area for gold, oil, or minerals

ex.en: The prospector spent years searching the hills for gold.
ex.zh: 那位探礦者花了好幾年在山中尋找黃金。

root.note: 往前看、尋找的人 → 探礦者

senses.en: a printed document describing a school, business, or investment
senses.zh: （學校、公司的）簡介；招股說明書

ex.en: Investors should read the prospectus carefully before buying shares.
ex.zh: 投資人在購買股票前應仔細閱讀公開說明書。

root.note: 讓人先看看的文件 → 簡介

senses.en: lying stretched out on the ground, face downward
completely overcome or exhausted
to lie face down, especially in worship or submission

ex.en: The exhausted runner lay prostrate on the grass after the race.
ex.zh: 那名精疲力竭的跑者賽後俯臥在草地上。

root.note: 向前整個攤平 → 俯臥的

mn: 別和 prostate（攝護腺）搞混，prostrate 多一個 r。

senses.en: the main character in a story, play, or film
a leading supporter of a cause

ex.en: The protagonist of the novel is a young girl searching for her father.
ex.zh: 這部小說的主角是一位尋找父親的年輕女孩。

root.note: 第一位演員 → 主角

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

ex.en: Wear sunscreen for protection against harmful rays.
ex.zh: 擦防曬乳來防護有害的紫外線。

root.note: 在前面遮蓋 → 保護

senses.en: intended to protect someone or something
wanting to protect someone from harm

ex.en: Workers must wear protective gloves when handling chemicals.
ex.zh: 工人處理化學品時必須戴防護手套。

root.note: 在前面遮蓋的 → 保護的

senses.en: a person or thing that protects

ex.en: The older brother saw himself as his sister's protector.
ex.zh: 哥哥把自己當成妹妹的保護者。

root.note: 遮蓋保護的人或物

senses.en: a member of a Western Christian church separated from the Roman Catholic Church
relating to Protestants or their churches

ex.en: She was raised in a Protestant family in Scotland.
ex.zh: 她在蘇格蘭一個新教家庭長大。

root.note: 公開表示抗議（天主教會）的人 → 新教徒

senses.en: the official rules for behavior on formal occasions
a set of rules for a procedure or for exchanging data

ex.en: The hospital follows a strict protocol for treating infections.
ex.zh: 這家醫院依照嚴格的規程治療感染。

root.note: 黏在文件最前面的一頁 → 正式規範

senses.en: the first martyr of a cause or country

ex.en: Saint Stephen is traditionally called the protomartyr of Christianity.
ex.zh: 聖司提反傳統上被稱為基督教的第一位殉道者。

root.note: 第一位殉道者

senses.en: the living substance inside a cell

ex.en: Under the microscope, we could see the protoplasm moving inside the cell.
ex.zh: 在顯微鏡下，我們看得到細胞內的原生質在流動。

root.note: 最初形成的物質 → 原生質

senses.en: a first model of something from which other forms are developed

ex.en: The engineers tested a prototype of the new electric car.
ex.zh: 工程師測試了新款電動車的原型。

root.note: 第一個模型 → 原型

senses.en: to make something last longer than expected or necessary

ex.en: Lawyers on both sides tried to protract the trial.
ex.zh: 雙方律師都試圖拖延審判。

root.note: 往前拉長 → 延長

senses.en: to stick out from a surface

ex.en: Sharp rocks protrude from the water at low tide.
ex.zh: 退潮時，尖銳的岩石會突出水面。

root.note: 往前推出來 → 突出

senses.en: something that sticks out

ex.en: The climber grabbed a small protrusion in the rock wall.
ex.zh: 攀岩者抓住岩壁上一個小小的突出處。

root.note: 往前推出的東西 → 突出物

senses.en: a thing that bulges or swells out from a surface

ex.en: The doctor examined a small protuberance on the patient's wrist.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查病人手腕上的一個小隆起。

root.note: 往外腫起 → 隆起

senses.en: bulging or swelling outward

ex.en: The frog stared at us with its protuberant eyes.
ex.zh: 青蛙用牠凸出的眼睛盯著我們。

root.note: 往外腫起的 → 突出的

senses.en: to bulge or swell outward

ex.en: The tree roots began to protuberate through the old sidewalk.
ex.zh: 樹根開始從老舊的人行道下隆起。

root.note: 往外腫起 → 隆起

senses.en: a short, well-known saying that gives advice or states a truth

ex.en: An old proverb says, "Actions speak louder than words."
ex.zh: 一句古老的諺語說：「行動勝於空談。」

root.note: 廣為流傳的話 → 諺語

senses.en: making or showing careful preparation for the future

ex.en: Provident families put aside money for emergencies.
ex.zh: 有遠見的家庭會存錢以備急用。

root.note: 往前看的 → 有遠見的

senses.en: happening at a favorable time; lucky, as if arranged by God

ex.en: A providential rainstorm put out the forest fire.
ex.zh: 一場及時雨撲滅了森林大火。

root.note: 像天意安排的 → 幸運的

senses.en: relating to a province or region
narrow-minded or unsophisticated

ex.en: His provincial attitudes changed after he traveled abroad.
ex.zh: 他出國旅行後，狹隘的觀念改變了。

root.note: 地方省份的 → 見識不廣的

senses.en: a condition attached to an agreement

ex.en: He agreed to lend the car, with the proviso that she return it by noon.
ex.zh: 他同意借車，但條件是她要在中午前還回來。

root.note: 事先看好、說明的條件 → 但書

senses.en: an action or speech that makes someone angry, especially deliberately

ex.en: He lost his temper at the slightest provocation.
ex.zh: 他稍微被激一下就發脾氣。

root.note: 把人叫出來 → 挑釁

senses.en: skill or expertise in a particular activity
bravery in battle

ex.en: The team is known for its prowess on defense.
ex.zh: 這支球隊以強大的防守能力聞名。

parts.m: brave, valiant 英勇的（古法文 prou）

root.note: 英勇 → 高超的本領

senses.en: directly or immediately, as the nearest cause

ex.en: The fire was proximately caused by a faulty wire.
ex.zh: 這場火的直接原因是一條故障的電線。

root.note: 最接近地 → 直接地

senses.en: the authority to act or vote for another person, or the person given it
something used to represent or measure something else

ex.en: Since she could not attend, she voted by proxy.
ex.zh: 因為她無法出席，所以委託代理人投票。

root.note: 代理職務 → 代理人

senses.en: the quality of being careful and sensible about the future

ex.en: Financial prudence helped the family survive the recession.
ex.zh: 理財謹慎讓這個家庭撐過了經濟衰退。

parts.m: foresee 預見（拉丁文 providentia 的縮略）

root.note: 能預見未來 → 謹慎

senses.en: involving or showing care and forethought, especially in business
senses.zh: 審慎的；出於謹慎考量的

ex.en: The bank raised its reserves for prudential reasons.
ex.zh: 銀行基於審慎考量提高了準備金。

root.note: 謹慎的

senses.en: the quality of being easily shocked by matters relating to sex or nudity

ex.en: The film was banned in some places because of old-fashioned prudery.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為老派的假正經觀念而在某些地方被禁。

root.note: 拘謹過頭的態度

senses.en: having or encouraging too much interest in sexual matters

ex.en: The tabloid appealed to readers' prurient curiosity about celebrities.
ex.zh: 那份八卦小報迎合讀者對名人的窺淫好奇心。

root.note: 心癢難耐的 → 好色的

senses.en: a false apostle; one who falsely claims to be a messenger of a faith

ex.en: The early church warned believers against every pseudapostle who asked for money.
ex.zh: 早期教會警告信徒提防每個索討錢財的假使徒。

root.note: 假的使徒

senses.en: a false name used by an author or other person

ex.en: The author published her first novel under a pseudonym.
ex.zh: 這位作家用筆名出版了她的第一本小說。

root.note: 假的名字 → 筆名

senses.en: the state of using a false name

ex.en: Online pseudonymity lets users speak freely without revealing their identity.
ex.zh: 網路上使用化名讓用戶可以自由發言而不暴露身分。

root.note: 用假名的狀態

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with mental illness

ex.en: After medical school, he chose to specialize in psychiatry.
ex.zh: 醫學院畢業後，他選擇專攻精神醫學。

root.note: 治療心靈的醫學

senses.en: relating to powers of the mind beyond natural laws, such as telepathy
a person claiming such powers
relating to the mind

ex.en: The psychic claimed she could read people's thoughts.
ex.zh: 那位靈媒聲稱她能讀出別人的想法。

root.note: 心靈的 → 通靈的

senses.en: having a mental disorder marked by a lack of empathy and antisocial behavior
senses.zh: 精神病態的；反社會人格的

ex.en: The movie's villain was a psychopathic genius with no sense of guilt.
ex.zh: 電影的反派是一個毫無罪惡感的精神病態天才。

root.note: 心靈有病的 → 精神病態的

senses.en: the treatment of mental disorders by talking rather than by medicine

ex.en: Psychotherapy helped her cope with anxiety.
ex.zh: 心理治療幫助她應對焦慮。

root.note: 治療心靈

senses.en: slightly fat; chubby

ex.en: The baby reached for the toy with pudgy little hands.
ex.zh: 嬰兒用胖嘟嘟的小手去抓玩具。

senses.en: childishly silly and immature

ex.en: The comedian's puerile jokes did not amuse the adult audience.
ex.zh: 那位喜劇演員幼稚的笑話沒能逗樂成年觀眾。

root.note: 像小孩的 → 幼稚的

senses.en: eager or quick to argue, quarrel, or fight

ex.en: The pugnacious senator attacked every proposal from the other party.
ex.zh: 那位好鬥的參議員攻擊對方政黨的每一項提案。

root.note: 愛打架的 → 好鬥的

mn: pug 是鬥牛犬般的「狗臉」，聯想愛打架的樣子。

senses.en: having great power or influence (archaic)

ex.en: The puissant king commanded the largest army in Europe.
ex.zh: 那位強大的國王統領著歐洲最大的軍隊。

parts.m: be able 能夠（古法文 poeir）

root.note: 有能力的 → 強大的

senses.en: relating to the lungs

ex.en: Smoking greatly increases the risk of pulmonary disease.
ex.zh: 吸菸會大幅增加肺部疾病的風險。

root.note: 肺的
